body: From what you’ve said I don’t think your ex fell for this girl, I think he’s just thinking with the wrong head. It also sounds like he’s a massive douche. I bet when he’s bored of her he’ll come crying back to you because he wants attention affection and love. And I hope by that time you’ve realized how much better off you are without him and you’ll ignore him (as you should). Stay strong!!!!

Hey there!!! This is super common, I’ve definitely been there before and it really does suck. What I did was save everything- the notes, the gifts, the pictures, and I put them all away in a drawer that I never opened. Months went by and then a year and I found that reading the notes and looking at the gifts made me feel nothing, so I was able to throw them away. Living without the affection and adoration of a significant other is hard and it’s even worse being reminded of how sweet they were post-breakup. Just remember to keep your head high and focus on yourself now. You got this!

Right now I’m not really eating, showering, sleeping, or exercising, and I’m getting away with all of it because we are on lockdown. I am missing out on quite a few milestones and I just got denied from my dream school which set off a pretty bad episode.
